usage: The phrase '沖涼' is used as a verb phrase meaning 'to take a shower.'
It can be placed after a subject to describe the action someone is doing in the morning or after coming home.
'沖涼' can be used in questions to ask if someone has taken a shower.
It is common to use '沖涼' with time expressions like '今朝' (this morning) or '夜晚' (evening).
The phrase can also be used in negative sentences by adding '未' before it to mean 'have not taken a shower yet.'
